notes: VALIDATION run. The December gated run 35105451803 measured P(reach 10%|signal) = 51.81% on 166 signals against a 22.55% ungated baseline -- but the gate values were derived from December means and tested on December, which is in-sample and the textbook setup for overfitting. This run replays the SAME gates UNCHANGED (min_chg_pct 7.0, max_bar_index 10, min_prior_day_range_pct 7.0) on January 2025, which was not used to derive them. Nothing is retuned. If P(reach 10%) holds near 50% the discriminator is real; if it collapses toward the 22.55% base rate it was overfitting and the December result becomes a negative finding. March 2025 remains untouched and is refused fail-closed by both the module and the workflow guard.
